owner_creation.analysis: The version exported object owns exactly [c_char; 4], created from 712 followed by NUL in the image, rather than a pointer to allocated memory.
owner_creation.invariant: The owner is the four-byte static array itself.
limitations: version is image storage rather than a heap string returned to a caller.

aliases_escapes.analysis: command.rs:1454-1463 lends version's address through PARG; optfunc.rs:1093 and lesskey_parse.rs:1642-1646 also borrow it for reading.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Callers receive a borrowed C string, not ownership.
limitations: Mutability is retained for the translated C ABI; arbitrary external symbol mutation is outside this source review.
An external C writer remains outside the maintained read-only call-site audit.

callback_targets.analysis: The version initializer transmute returns an array value; no slot can hold or dispatch a function pointer.
callback_targets.invariant: Version content is data and cannot be a callback.
limitations: Static array initialization registers no runtime callback.

invalidation.analysis: The address of version remains stable because maintained consumers do not resize, replace or overwrite its four bytes.
invalidation.invariant: Borrowed version pointers do not outlive image data.

mutation_commit.analysis: The version initializer establishes three digits and a trailing NUL before the executable enters main.
mutation_commit.invariant: Static initialization publishes a complete C string.

release_pair.analysis: This version object has no allocator pair or close operation; releasing the image at process exit ends its lifetime.
release_pair.invariant: Version pointers must never be passed to free.
limitations: free is invalid for version and every interior pointer into its four bytes.

error_cleanup.analysis: Readers cannot make a partial allocation commit because no allocation occurs; output errors leave the version array intact.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failed display leaves version bytes unchanged.

signals_handoff.analysis: Maintained callers read version; the definition registers no handler and grants no permission for an external writer.
signals_handoff.invariant: The review permits reads and excludes external writes.

src/command.rs.relationship: dispversion at src/command.rs:1454-1463 lends version bytes through PARG to error formatting, retaining neither an owning copy nor a free obligation.

src/optfunc.rs.relationship: The option handler at src/optfunc.rs:1085-1104 passes the image version string for output; no write or allocator release of version occurs in that consumer.

src/lesskey_parse.rs.relationship: Numeric version initialization at src/lesskey_parse.rs:1641-1647 reads version without replacing the static array or retaining mutable byte ownership.
